name: J. E. Hample
role: Hide buyer for Oberne, Hosick & Co., Chicago
bio: J. E. Hample was the traveling agent of the Chicago hide and leather firm Oberne, Hosick & Co., and in March 1884 he bought the hides at the Medora abattoir for about $20,000. He was back in Medora in October 1885, and the paper later noted he had several times bought the company's hides.
